title: Dana Mincer, DO (physician-led health plan founder) — Incorruptible 'gave me language for what I've believed for years: the metric is not the thing'
summary: Dana Mincer, DO — physician and founder of WOOP Care (physician-led, self-funded health plan solution) — publishes a patient-care reflection that ends in an Incorruptible frame. A patient told her she'd 'done ten times what her child's pediatrician had'; her only intervention was sitting with the mother for an hour and building the plan with her, not for her. Incorruptible, she writes, gave her language for what she'd believed for years: 15-minute visits measure activity, not whether a mother felt heard.
blockquote: I've been reading Incorruptible by Eric Ries, and it gave me language for what I've believed for years: the metric is not the thing. Fifteen-minute visits measure activity. They don't measure whether a mother felt heard.
attribution_title: Physician · Founder, WOOP Care (Physician-Led, Self-Funded Health Plan Solution) · Former D1 Athlete
